budget_items.topic: Marshall Park redevelopment scope and cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The original full master plan was scaled back from $19M to a $13.7M proposal, with a backup $6.46M reduced version.
budget_items.quote: the original $19m full master plan was scaled back to a $13.7m proposal focused on current field and recreation areas, with a backup $6.46m reduced version.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities Director developed a maintenance cost estimate for Marshall Park.
budget_items.quote: facilities director chris ruth developed a detailed maintenance cost estimate of $53,000 annually.

budget_items.topic: Cash gift for Lunenburg Adult Activity Center
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board accepted a monetary donation from Peter and Deborah Lincoln, designated for the Adult Activity Center.
budget_items.quote: the board voted to formally accept $6,900.00 monetary donation from peter and deborah lincoln, designated for the lunenburg adult activity center.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY2025 health insurance renewal showed a premium increase of approximately 15%; the Board raised concerns about sustainability.
budget_items.quote: susan shillue of cook & company provided a detailed overview of the fy2025 health insurance renewal, which showed a significant premium increase of approximately 15%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The anticipated 15% increase in health insurance premiums was the central concern in budget projections; the chair asked whether stabilization funds or grants might offset cost pressures.
budget_items.quote: a central concern raised during the discussion was the anticipated 15% increase in health insurance premiums.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board reviewed and signed an accounts payable warrant, which the Chair stated in this amount.
budget_items.quote: there is an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $1,562,534,57.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of mailing the warrant to all households; the Town Manager will look into printing and mailing costs. No cost figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: town manager warren-dyment agreed to look into printing and mailing costs and report back at a future meeting before any final decision is made.
